name: common
description: Shared utility primitives: typed OperationResult/StepStatus contracts, typed error hierarchy, UTC timezone normalization helpers, and unified Run/Step/Event execution model

capabilities.name: common.contracts
capabilities.description: Typed OperationResult, StepStatus (9 states), ErrorInfo/WarningInfo, and AgentForgeError hierarchy replacing ad-hoc success markers (result.py, errors.py)

capabilities.name: common.time_utils
capabilities.description: UTC normalization (to_utc_iso), ISO 8601 parsing with timezone, DST gap/fold handling, and offset formatting (time_utils.py)

capabilities.name: common.run
capabilities.description: Unified Run/Step/Event execution model: RunStatus/EventType/EventLevel enums, Event/Step/Run/RunResult dataclasses, RunRecorder/StepRecorder context managers, run_from_step_reports adapter (run.py)

health_checks.description: Verify common utility modules import including Run/Step/Event model
